name: BMF Player Sync
description: Feeds Omegga player identity records into the Brickadia Modding Framework player cache.
author: BMF

runtimeDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime for players.json when direct cache mode is used. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_RUNTIME_DIR is used.

bridgePluginName.description: Name of the loaded BMF Bridge plugin used for socket command delivery.

syncDelayMs.description: Debounce delay before writing a sync request after player list changes.

syncIntervalMs.description: Periodic fallback sync interval. Set to 0 to disable polling and rely only on Omegga join/leave/start/manual events.

maxCommandBytes.description: Maximum serialized bmf.players.sync command size. OMEGGA_BMF_PLAYER_SYNC_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES or BMF_UNIFIED_SOCKET_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES overrides this value.

connectionGeneration.description: Attach a UUID-keyed connection generation to plain player snapshots so BMF can reject controller identities from an earlier reconnect. OMEGGA_BMF_PLAYER_CONNECTION_GENERATION_ENABLED=1 also enables it.

brickadiaLogPath.description: Configurable explicit Brickadia.log path used when Omegga's live player list is empty.

includePositions.description: Include player positions in the BMF player cache and player-positions.json. OMEGGA_BMF_PLAYER_SYNC_POSITIONS overrides this value. Uses Omegga bulk positions first, a bounded targeted controller/pawn fallback second, and the BMF player-position snapshot when those are empty.

positionSnapshotPath.description: Optional explicit path for CityRPG/BMF player-positions.json. If blank, BMF_PLAYERS_POSITIONS_SNAPSHOT_PATH, CITYRPG_BMF_POSITION_SNAPSHOT_PATH, or runtimeDir/player-positions.json is used.

positionLimit.description: Maximum number of Omegga-tracked players to probe with the targeted position fallback.

positionTimeoutMs.description: Per-command timeout for the targeted position fallback.

forwardInteract.description: Forward Omegga interact events into BMF as bmf.interact.console commands. This is game-thread sensitive and should stay disabled unless a BMF Lua handler explicitly needs it. OMEGGA_BMF_FORWARD_INTERACT overrides this value.

interactCommand.description: BMF command used for forwarded interact messages.
